picks.title: Theker just raised $85M to build the factory robot that doesn't specialize in anything
picks.why_it_matters: An $85M round for modular industrial robotics signals strong investor appetite for flexible automation solutions that can address labor shortages across multiple manufacturing verticals—a thesis early-stage VCs can underwrite in adjacent robotics and industrial AI plays.

picks.title: Microsoft taps Alt Carbon in sign of India's growing role in carbon removal
picks.why_it_matters: A major enterprise buyer validating an India-based carbon removal startup after rigorous due diligence opens the door for early-stage climate tech deals in emerging markets with lower cost structures and growing technical talent.

picks.title: MiMo Code is now released and open-source
picks.why_it_matters: Xiaomi open-sourcing a competitive code model intensifies commoditization pressure on AI coding startups, signaling that early-stage bets in developer tools should focus on proprietary workflows and data moats rather than foundational models.
